schema_note: M0-T03 probe record. Every field below was observed, not assumed. Anything not observed is null with a reason.

hermes.install_source: git clone at the pinned commit, then an editable install (uv pip install -e .)
hermes.install_note: Owner approved the git install. A git+https wheel build is REFUSED BY UPSTREAM: setup.py raises RuntimeError('Building wheels or sdists for hermes-agent is not supported. Hermes is distributed via the shell installer, Docker image, or Nix.'). The supported paths are the shell installer, Docker, Nix, or an editable install from a clone. The editable install at the pinned commit succeeded and the API surface below was read from 0.21.3 itself. For the M3 runtime, Docker is the right choice: it matches upstream's supported distribution and the isolation plan section 4.2 already requires.

observed_controls.routing: base_url, api_key, provider, api_mode, model, switch_model()
observed_controls.provider_substitution: fallback_model, providers_allowed/ignored/order - must be left unset; the plan forbids automatic substitution

hermes.custom_tool_injection_finding: Confirmed on 0.21.3, not only 0.19.0. AIAgent.__init__ exposes none of mcp_servers, tools, extra_tools, custom_tools or tool_registry, and toolsets.create_custom_toolset(name, description, tools, includes) composes existing tool NAMES only. EpisAlpha's typed tools therefore reach Hermes over MCP, configured by file (mcp.json under $HERMES_HOME/~/.hermes). MCP tools surface with an 'mcp_' name prefix, which create_custom_toolset can then allowlist: EpisAlpha MCP server -> mcp.json -> create_custom_toolset('episalpha', tools=['mcp_...']) -> enabled_toolsets=['episalpha']. This is the M3-T01/M3-T03 design, still to be proven with a working probe before the runtime is built on it.
hermes.end_to_end_agent_run_reason: Not attempted. M0-T03 stops before building a runtime, and driving a real agent turn with EpisAlpha tools depends on the MCP adapter decision above.

model_route.pricing_note: No pricing field observed in the usage payload, so cost stays unknown (plan section 3.8, acceptance row A22).

consequences_for_episalpha: Structured final output must come from forced tool-call arguments, never from response_format. The OpenAI-compatible surface accepts response_format and silently ignores it, returning prose - a silent failure, not an error.
The bounded output repair in plan section 3.6 step 7 has a concrete justification: the host must validate and repair candidate JSON itself.
glm-5.3 is a reasoning model: trivial answers cost 600-1600 completion tokens. The 4000-token per-call cap in plan section 3.8 is workable but tight, and should be measured again at M3-T02.
Hermes exact-pins its dependencies, so it must live in its own environment or container and never share the application virtualenv (plan section 4.2).
